- [LEXP.7.3a.1] **Chained `**` consequence.** Because `**` is
    right-associative ([LGRA.9.5], [LEXP.1.3]), `a ** b ** c` is `a ** (b ** c)`,
    and [LEXP.7.3a] types each power on its own. The outer power is `Int` only
    when `b ** c` is a compile-time-known non-negative integer, and is otherwise
    `Float`, computed by [LEXP.7.3a]'s correctly rounded `pow`. So
    `a ** b ** 2` with a runtime `b` is `Float`, and every chain compiles.
